== Documentation ==
The documentation comments for this script come from the <code>DefaultCounterQuestIncOnDeath.psc</code> source file.

<source>
Once this ALIAS dies it increments the counter on its Quest's DefaultCounterQuest script.
</source>

=== Property ===
These are the property members for this script.

{{Script_Object_Member_Summary
| title = CheckForOnDyingInstead
| script = [[SFM:Script-DefaultCounterQuestIncOnDeath|DefaultCounterQuestIncOnDeath]]
| name = [[SFM:Script-DefaultCounterQuestIncOnDeath/CheckForOnDyingInstead|CheckForOnDyingInstead]]
| kind = Property
| flags = Auto Const
| returns = bool
| parameters = false
| documentation = If true the Increment will happen when this actor recieves the OnDying() event instead, which happens the instant the actor dies, unlike the
	OnDeath() event which can happen several seconds later.
}}

{{Script_Object_Member_Summary
| title = SupportRespawning
| script = [[SFM:Script-DefaultCounterQuestIncOnDeath|DefaultCounterQuestIncOnDeath]]
| name = [[SFM:Script-DefaultCounterQuestIncOnDeath/SupportRespawning|SupportRespawning]]
| kind = Property
| flags = Auto Const
| returns = bool
| parameters = false
| documentation = If true then this script will reset after incrementing in order to allow the next respawned actor that fills it to increment upon death as well.
}}
